Usage: selenium-pw-migrator --mode <mode> [options]

Use `selenium-pw-migrator --mode <mode> --help` for command-specific help.

Modes:
  Stable public commands:
    init               Create a safe starter migration workspace with the onboarding wizard.
    runbook            Generate a practical migration plan for a project before the first run.
    framework-matrix   Write explicit source and target test-framework support, detection, and readiness reports.
    playground         Create a five-minute public demo workspace with ready commands and expected outputs.
    playground-verify  Verify that a generated playground still has the complete public-demo contract.
    release-doctor     Check NuGet preview readiness before publishing the dotnet tool.
    analyze            Parse and analyze Selenium tests without generating target files.
    migrate            Parse, adapt, and generate Playwright target files.
    verify             Validate generated code quality with syntax/TODO/config checks.
    verify-project     Project-aware verification for generated Playwright .NET code.
    doctor             Preflight diagnostics and safe setup repair planning for migration workflows.
    evidence-pack      Create a redacted shareable zip from migration run artifacts.
    capabilities       List built-in source frontends and target backends with support status.
    config-validate    Validate adapter-config structure and agent-safety rules.
    config-diff        Compare adapter-config/profile documents and highlight risky agent changes.
    guard              Compare two migration artifact directories and fail on regressions.
    propose            Generate mapping proposals from migration artifacts.
    discover-target    Scan a target Playwright .NET project and collect infrastructure facts.
    index-pom          Scan Selenium PageObjects/source files and target Playwright/Kontur POMs for selector evidence.
    helper-inventory   Scan helper/POM method bodies and infer MethodSemantics candidates.
    scaffold   
[truncated]
